title: Board readiness runbook and decision scenarios for Q2 roadmap
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce a concise, decision-oriented packet and runbook to ensure board and exec stakeholders leave the Q2 roadmap readout aligned on priorities, asks, and contingencies. The packet will include: 1) One-slide strategic context and OKR alignment; 2) Three prioritized investment asks with clear success metrics and trade-offs; 3) Decision scenarios (optimistic / constrained capacity / conservative) mapping asks to outcomes and risks; 4) Ask tracker and ownership; 5) Appendix: cost/latency impact model, risk heatmap, and dependency map.
agenda_template:
- 0:00 Intro & objective (PM)
- 0:05 Strategic context & OKRs (PM)
- 0:12 Investment asks (PM leads)
- 0:25 Decision scenarios & recommended path (PM + Eng)
- 0:35 Risk & mitigation (Security/Compliance, Eng)
- 0:40 Q&A and commitments (Execs)
- 0:50 Close & next steps
decision_scenarios: Optimistic: Approve Ask A (Dedicated capacity + Optimize tooling). Expected outcome: 20% latency improvement and 12% cost reduction via batching; metric: p95 latency falls below 120ms. Trade-offs: delayed smaller cross-team features.

Constrained capacity: Approve Ask B (Targeted console & observability investment). Expected outcome: improved alerting and rollout safety; metric: reduction in P0 incidents by 30%. Trade-offs: slower performance gains.

Conservative: Defer major infra asks, fund experiments for Optimize toolkit. Expected outcome: preserves runway but increases technical risk; metric: maintain current SLOs while trialing caching experiments.
open_questions: Which metric bucket will finance require for cost/benefit comparisons?
Is the board comfortable with a phased rollout (canary -> A/B -> global)?
Do we need a separate compliance appendix for private deployments?
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Approving large infra spend without rollout guardrails. Mitigation: Include canary + automatic fallback policy in rollout plan.
Risk: Board requests faster time-to-value than our timeline. Mitigation: Offer a fast-follow small-scope pilot with measurable KPIs.
Risk: Missing cross-team dependencies (Dedicated autoscaling changes). Mitigation: Pre-commit dependency owners and schedule a cross-functional dry run.
rehearsal_plan: Mar 13: Full dry run with execs + engineering (60min)
Mar 16: Final slide polish + pre-reads distributed to board
acceptance_criteria: Decision packet contains explicit asks with success metrics
Deck approved by VP Eng and Security lead
Rehearsal completed with no open critical issues
